title: I want to suggest "One Flew Over The Cuckoo's Nest"

commenti.body: Solid video especially with the editing. So your intention is to get people to go watch the movie correct? If so then I think it's fair that a lot of your points were surface level & didn't really say anything special. One piece of advice I'd like to give though is to use your real voice or if you're too shy try to get one of your buddies to do the voice over for you. When you use tts it just comes off as so damn sterile & especially in the beginning it felt like I was watching a chatgpt narration. Other than that I enjoyed it & I'll say it again your editing is really solid & it helped make the video move by quickly which is important for a quick introduction to the movie. Best of luck with your channel hope to see you succeed :)

Thanks for your comment so much. It really inspired me. I wanted to make with my own voice, but I have a slight accent. Giving spoilers it's little to cruel for this movie. You need to watch it at least once in your life or read a book.
